info.name: Shoplytics API
info.description: Shoplytics backend v1.1. Start Docker deps + `npm run seed`, then run 'Auth > 1. Login as seeded users' first. Folder 'RBAC checks' asserts the authorization matrix. Run the collection with the Collection Runner for a full smoke test.

item.name: 1. Login as seeded users (run first)
item.description: Run this folder first: it stores a token per role in collection variables.

exec: const l = pm.response.json().data; if (l.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', l[0].id);
const l = pm.response.json().data; if (l.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('customerId', l[0].id);
const l = pm.response.json().data; if (l.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', l[0].id);

item.name: RBAC checks
item.description: Run after logging in. Seeded roles for the first business: owner=OWNER, admin=ADMIN, manager=MANAGER, analyst=ANALYST, outsider=no membership.
